_schema.description: Site-wide metadata. last_updated is written by scripts/refresh.py after a successful refresh and shown in the footer.

fields.last_updated: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last successful data refresh
fields.previous_election: {date, tpp: {ALP, LNP}}: statewide 2PP at the last election, used as the baseline for uniform-swing seat estimates
fields.key_dates: Key-dates strip: {countdowns: [{label, at (ISO with offset), today (text on the day), after (text once passed)}], events: [{from, to (optional, inclusive), text, short (a few words for the one-line strip on phones), ongoing (optional: a stretch between milestones, e.g. counting continues)}]}. The full strip shows 'Today:' (the narrowest event covering today) and 'Next,' (the next milestone). The phone line shows 'Today:' only on a milestone's first day, otherwise 'Next: <date>, <short>'; ongoing events are never a milestone
fields.sample_data: Map of dataset name -> true while that file still holds placeholder rows (drives the 'sample data' banner)
fields.sources: Map of source name -> {status: ok | error | placeholder, url, last_success, message}
fields.reconciliation: Written by scripts/refresh.py after the ABC district pages: lower-house candidates compared with the ABC A-Z list. {date (Melbourne), scope, abc_list_url, totals: {tracker, abc_list}, tracker_by_source: {abc, wikipedia, report}, only_in_tracker, only_on_abc (missing from the tracker before this run; added), unmatched_electorates, tracked_all (active candidates in both houses, shown in the footer)}
fields.nominations: Nominations badge on the home page: {opens, closes (ISO with offset; by hand), official (count of VEC-nominated candidates, both houses), official_at (when that count was taken)}; official/official_at are written by refresh.py once the VEC nominations file is loaded, and stay null until then
fields.reconciliation_electiontracker: Written by scripts/refresh.py after the ABC step: candidacies listed by electiontracker.au (open data, CC BY 4.0) compared with candidates.json and regions.json tickets. {date (Melbourne), source, data_url, credit, totals: {listed, active, missing_from_tracker}, missing_from_tracker: [{contest, chamber, name, party, status, note?}]}. Report only: names are never added from it, and only name, party, contest and status are read

previous_election.note: Statewide two-party-preferred at the 2022 election, the baseline for the swing-adjusted seat margins.
